limitations: Only the requested two M0 workflows were accepted. No full engine feature matrix, all 165 upstream tests, or upstream release/typecheck claim is inferred from this task.

GPU: headed Chromium 156.0.8078.4 on NVIDIA Blackwell / RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU, WebGPUBackend, isFallbackAdapter=false. Viewport 1280x720, DPR 1, engine canvases 960x540; this is NOT a 1080p performance benchmark or broad hardware certification.
M0 path mode is software-triangle-BVH compute on physical GPU, not hardware RT. Screenshots show prototype sampling noise. No production renderer or denoiser acceptance is claimed.
Cold verification restarts dev server and launches a fresh browser/context; retained compiler caches are permitted. It does not claim full dependency reinstallation on every cold launch.
Snapshot verification covers the documented probe snapshot (tick/transforms/components/input/topology) and exact restore in this test, not general long-term saves or version migration.

Both production dist runs served files exclusively from their own dist directory with engine dev servers stopped and no development control exposed. Harmless favicon.ico 404 is retained in runtime reports.

The missing material negative emitted both a coarse TC_STATIC_REFERENCE position at game.ts:1:1 and a precise TC_TS_2304 at game.ts:72:19. The precise diagnostic satisfies source location verification; coarse duplicate retained, engine not modified.
Initial browser test-harness failures and evidence-wrapper correction are retained and explicitly classified in flows.incidents. No failed engine source was patched or hidden.
